verdict.rationale: Linear's own Linear Agent produces AI-generated output from workspace data inside the product. 'Write with Agent' reviews changes since the last update plus linked Slack messages and drafts a project update. Guided Reviews explain what changed in a diff and why. Feedback is automatically labeled and prioritized. Loops update plans and explain what changed and who needs to act. Linear Agent also investigates newly reported issues. Missing for 10: AI-driven analytical insights or trend analysis over workspace data (dashboards come only via integrations), explicit proactive suggestion surfaces, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
